answer:
this should return the results you expect

df = (spark.read.option('header', True)
               .option('multiline', True)
               .option('mode', 'PERMISSIVE')
               .option('quote', '"')
               .option('escape', '"')
               .csv('yourpath/CSVFilename.csv'))
display(df)
